newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco C.bank withdraws 340 mln dirhams at auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco C.bank withdraws 340 mln dirhams at auction.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) withdrew 340 million dirhams ($35.8 million) from the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, a bank official said on Friday.

The bank received bids totalling 5.151 billion dirhams and allocated 3.575 billion dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was less than the 3.915 billion dirhams leaving the market this week, the official said.
It satisfied 69.40 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on May 7, 1997.
